first_comment: One sea muppet sat misfiled in a museum's invertebrate collection for years, because it was caught on a trip hunting for shellfish-like animals. Would you name it differently? 😄

stories.headline: Seahorse lookalikes turned out to be a whole new group
stories.summary: CT scans and DNA show 3 thumb-sized 'sea muppets' from southern Australia's deep reefs aren't seahorses at all. Evolution built the same body shape twice. A new species, the helmethead, was named.
stories.why: An entire genus hid misfiled in museum drawers for decades.

stories.headline: Diet plus exercise put 54% of young adults' diabetes in remission
stories.summary: In a 96-person trial for type 2 diabetes under 45, a low-calorie diet with supervised workouts led 27 of 50 people to remission in 6 months, versus 2 of 46 on usual care.
stories.why: It also burned fat while protecting muscle; longer studies come next.

stories.stat_label: more power once the upgrade is done
stories.headline: Spacewalkers added a 7th new solar wing to the space station
stories.summary: NASA's Anil Menon and Canada's Joshua Kutryk spent 7 hours 11 minutes outside installing a roll-out solar array. One more array will lift power from 160 kW to about 215 kW.
stories.why: It was U.S. spacewalk number 100, and Kutryk's very first.

stories.stat_label: year the old limit was set
stories.headline: An Indian scientist beat a shortcut limit that stood since 1996
stories.summary: Manoj Gupta at IIT Gandhinagar found a smarter way to estimate shortest routes across huge networks, keeping the 'at most double' accuracy promise even for nearby points, with no slowdown.
stories.why: Maps, internet traffic and brain networks all rely on fast distance estimates like these.

fun_fact: All 7 known sea muppets were caught by accident in nets or dredges 50 to 125 m down.
